text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(――It's been a while since 
Trainer-san became my trainer.)
choice_data_list: So in this case, you'd use……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(……And, today, like most days,
they're teaching me English)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Hmmmmm~. I'm the one that asked,
but is this really okay~? 
This person is supposed to be my trainer
for running)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Fundamentally,
they're a serious person. You could say 
their passion and seriousness are on full
display)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaa…… Haaa……!
『The last straight!! Keep going!!』
『The last straight!! Keep going!!』

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Back then,
they were really really passionate……)
『That's not all you've got!!』
『That's not all you've got!!』

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I wondered why they were so desperate~)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(But,
it really was something that they could keep
coming up with those lines.
……that's what happens when you 
have a wide vocabulary, I guess? Right?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(They're really enthusiastic. 
……When I think back, it's a little……)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fu, fufuu……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah. I'm listening, I was listening! 
Sorry, I'll properly…… ummmm, this word~……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(This won't do.
It's pretty rude to stop listening and
think 
about other things when I'm the one that asked,
isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(They're really busy,
and still taking the time to teach 
me…… but when I think about it,
isn't that bad? I asked 
for something that's not their job)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Gratitude~? To your trainer?
Isn't it fine either way? 
Isn't it normal for them to look after
you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm~? Is that how it is? 
Is it really okay to include studying in
that?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that just how it is? Besides,
if your grades are bad, 
doesn't that mean you won't be able to
properly train? 
There's supplementary lessons after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~……I suppose so?
So I guess that means this is just 
one part of a trainer's work too…… huh~?
Really~??

text_block_list.name: Dream-chasing Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa……! Trainer-san, 
let's keep going! I can still run!

text_block_list.name: Dream-chasing Trainer
text_block_list.text: I know. But, no. We're stopping here.

text_block_list.name: Dream-chasing Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
But! In the next race…… I definitely want
to win!

text_block_list.name: Dream-chasing Trainer
text_block_list.text:
There's the next race,
and the one after that right? Which means 
we should think about the future too.
So we can keep winning……!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Focusing on victory,
huh? Even just watching them as an 
outsider,
I can tell there's a difference in
passion~)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san is more like them, right? 
I wonder if they have any thoughts about
that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even with that difference,
I wonder if it's still fun~. 
They're not getting bored right~?……wait,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(……Heh.
They're humming while getting ready)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, are you…… having fun now?
choice_data_list: Of course! I'm expecting great things!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
O-oh…… you're energetic even before training,
huh?
choice_data_list: You can do it! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wai-,
why are you as enthusiastic as when I'm
running? 
……Fuu, ahahahaa. You're too spirited!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(……Are they doing that on purpose?
Are they trying to be 
considerate?
Or is a conversation like this part of the
『fun』?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: …… Okaaaay.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(While I might not be able to match that
energy and enthusiasm…… 
just watching Trainer-san is kinda fun for
me too)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well…… guess I can just think about it
later. 
For now, I'll do my best today too~.
